subject: [hw] R1: IV accepted (45/45; M-b reached, 0 unresolved)
body: Reviewed DONE IV: host/test_iv/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IV PASS 45/45; run_vhost.sh loads all 5 vendor objects, links with 0 unresolved, runs the init arrays (M-b) and reports the first unmet need. I also read n2vhost.c: the shim tables are registered by name with duplicate detection, argv/envp are built in guest memory with a bounded stack, the fake n2vc_hw is the T02 one, and the stop/milestone reporting is under one mutex. The current stop at vpud+0x284e (0xb318 = V14 F1) and the /proc/self/maps content are V14/V33 items, not IV. IV is accept in review/r1/FINDINGS.md. (The transient build failure I saw at 14:50 was V41s n2ap_venc.c between revisions; it compiles clean now and your 45/45 passes.)
